quotes.text: At present, the majority of heads of a household are male. This is because the HOH is defined to be the male in a couple or where more than one person has equal claim to be HOH and they are of opposite sex. The HRP will take into account accommodation ownership / rental, income and age in order to identify the HRP (see Volume 3 of this User Guide for more details).
